main_body: Snow-capped wooden crate or shelf: a snow slab on top, with a front of tan planks between dark posts below it
top_band: Rows 2-9: white and pale blue-grey snow band with a lighter highlight, then icicle tips at rows 9-10
evidence: Down the middle column, the snow band (rows 2-9) is a clear horizontal surface, much shorter than the body. A light-blue icicle row marks the front edge at about row 9-10. The wooden front face (rows 10-25) sits below it, with dark posts and dark-outlined planks that read as inset. There is no real eave shadow, since the tan face starts straight under the icicles. The object is a snow-topped prop, not organic, so kind_matches is false.

style.evidence: The snow has about 4-5 tones and some clump variation, which is decent. The wood planks are large, nearly flat tan blocks of about 5x5 px with almost no grain or dots. The dark frame and bars are a tinted brown and blue-grey, not pure black. Overall it is thinner and flatter than the stall and well references, and its tiles carry fewer colours.
